notes.title: An update on Neural Dominion's forthcoming demo.
notes.notes:
Hey Cyberheads!

We want to thank you for your incredible feedback on our invite-only demo. After careful consideration, we've decided to delay our public demo to ensure we have enough time to make the necessary fixes for a more polished and enjoyable experience for everyone. 

As a result, we won't be participating in the October Steam Next Fefst. Instead, we're preparing for a demo release in 2025. Our team is working hard to bring you the best experience possible in Technograd!

In the meantime, stay tuned for sneak peeks into Neural Dominion's gangs, their unique playstyles, and much more over the next few months. 

Thank you for your continued support and for being such a dedicated playerbase. We can't wait to share more of Neural Dominion with you!

-GamesBond Studios & Camlann Games

notes.title: Neural Dominion is a cyberpunk 4X strategy game crammed with crime
notes.notes:
With Civilization 7 on the way, we can expect another serious contender to the ranks of the best 4X games around. It's a very historically driven genre, however, so games like Stellaris and Age of Wonders 4 that step outside the traditional boundaries of the Crusader Kings and Europa Universalis series always catch the eye. So it is with newcomer Neural Dominion. Combining the crime-dense neon streets of Cyberpunk 2077 with the overarching strategy game structure of Civ and a little splash of that XCOM-style street combat for good measure, this is shaping up to be one of the most distinctive 4X offerings we've seen in a while.

notes.title: New digs, ya heard?
notes.notes:
New digs, ya heard? 

Hey cyberheads,

We’re back and we’ve got some exciting updates for you. Behind the scenes, Ataxia has undergone a major transformation and is now titled Neural Dominion. The devs are in the dev grind and making significant progress. In fact, we have an announcement. 

We’ll be showcasing the game at the upcoming October Steam Next Fest, which runs from Oct. 14 – Oct. 21. There will be a public demo of Neural Dominion where you can experience what we’ve been making, dominating enemy factions through mind implants, psychogenic toxins, or a good old-fashioned sniper rifle. Technograd won’t know what hit it. 

[previewyoutube=y4NwWP9IBCo;full][/previewyoutube]


That’s all for now. See you soon!

-GamesBond Studios & Camlann Games

notes.title: Announcement Trailer Live Now
notes.notes:
ANNOUNCING: The trailer for Ataxia is finally here! 

Showcasing gameplay, win conditions, global powers, building, combat, and a preview of the city of Technograd, this video explains what Ataxia is all about: winning no matter the cost.


[previewyoutube=o31aKiAnpBY;full][/previewyoutube]


Set in the cyberpunk future, Ataxia blends the elements of a complex strategy game with a gritty dystopian twist. Choose one of the gangs, build your team, research tech and cybernetics, use the city to your advantage, and take out your opponents.

Wishlist on Steam and stay tuned for new announcements. Follow @ataxia4x on all socials, and be sure to join the conversation on [url=https://discord.gg/DgSkeDpVxz]Discord[/url].
